text: There are some things that should anger us: injustices in the world when people are mistreated. You can be angered when you have been mistreated, or perhaps sometimes you are angered just by the brokenness of this world. Sometimes when we are angry, the source is really clear—we know it's this person who's wronged us or wronged someone else.
